destinations.description: Native metadata for each named Project destination. Explicit values override derived values.

icon.description: Name of the icon asset icons/<name>.png that destinations publish. Create it with stemma icon or commit a square PNG.

setup_file.description: Setup-relative path or glob selecting the file Intune records as the setup entry point. It may name any file, such as a wrapper script. signer.description: Expected publisher identity: apple:developer-id:<TEAMID> or authenticode:<SHA256>. Use stemma signature to inspect the input and derive it.

signature.description: Require a complete Authenticode signature from the configured publisher on the setup file.

source.description: Vendor installer, setup directory or ZIP or TAR archive holding a setup directory, or a resource output. A WindowsSoftware document requires a source.

bundle_id.description: Application bundle identifier, combined with any supplied path selectors.

installed_path.description: Observed absolute installation path, when the installer declares one.

kind.description: Observed subject kind: app, package or msi.

path.description: Exact path within the inspected artifact.
